summary.zh: 判断是否签约伙伴并设计分层、分成与联合 GTM
summary.en: Decide whether to partner, at what tier and on what revshare

description.zh: 评估是否与某家伙伴签约、适合哪种层级（推荐、分销、OEM、系统集成或联盟），并设计分成结构与联合上市方式。适合拓展新渠道前做合作结构设计。
description.en: Decides whether to sign a partner, which tier fits (referral, reseller, OEM, SI or alliance), and how revenue share and joint go-to-market should work. Useful before committing to a new channel.
